text:
maya: Quick docs PR question — the webhook callback example currently shows the payload as an array, but runtime now wraps events in an object with an `events` field (changed in server PR #4623). Which should the canonical example use?

maya: Incorrect example currently in page:
```json
[
  { "type": "message.created", "id": "evt_123", "data": { ... } },
  { "type": "message.updated", "id": "evt_124", "data": { ... } }
]
```

maya: Runtime returns this shape (preferred):
```json
{
  "events": [
    { "type": "message.created", "id": "evt_123", "data": { ... } },
    { "type": "message.updated", "id": "evt_124", "data": { ... } }
  ],
  "delivery_id": "del_789"
}
```

maya: Also noticed SDK snippets use `webhook_url` while OpenAPI and runtime use `callback_url`. We should standardize to `callback_url` and add a migration note. @ben can you take the examples?

ben: Yep. I'll update the Node/Python/Go snippets to `callback_url` and change both example locations (prose + OpenAPI example block). I'll include a short migration blurb: "In v1.0, top-level array responses were replaced by an object with `events`; also `webhook_url` was renamed to `callback_url`."

akshay: Couple of small requests: add `Content-Type: application/json` in cURL examples, include `curl -N`/`--no-buffer` for SSE examples, and in the JS fetch snippet check `response.ok` before parsing.

jen: Don't forget the /webhooks/subscribe OpenAPI example — we accidentally had a different snippet there. Also add an example response schema block so the JSON sample rendering picks up the right shape.

ben: Will do. Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4899 — fixes JSON examples, SDK snippets, cURL flags, and adds migration note. Draft commit 3f4d9a2.

docs-bot: PR 4899 created by ben — labels: docs, needs-review (maya, jen). CI: docs-build pending.

maya: Once CI passes merge and then add a short changelog entry under docs/releases. Thanks!

ben: ETA ~20m to push fixes and update OpenAPI examples. Ping if anything else.
